theorem ComputesInTime.of_spaceUsed_le {M : FinTM Bool} {x w : List Bool} {t s : ℕ}
    (h : M.ComputesInTime x w t) (hs : M.tm.spaceUsed (M.tm.initCfg x) t ≤ s) :
    M.ComputesInTime x w (M.configBound x.length s) := by
  classical
  rw [computesInTime_iff] at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨hhalt, hout⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨T, hTt, hmin, heq⟩ :=
    MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt M.tm (M.tm.initCfg x) hhalt
  have hT : (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T).state = none :=
    (congrArg Cfg.state heq).trans hhalt
  -- bounds on heads and nonblank cells up to time `t`
  have hbound : ∀ t' ≤ t, ∀ i, |(M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t').workTapePos i| ≤ s ∧
      ∀ z, (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t').workTapes i z ≠ none → |z| ≤ s := by
    intro t' ht' i
    have hcard : (M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg x) t i).card ≤ s := by
      simpa only [MultiTapeTM.spaceUsedByTape_eq_card] using
        (M.tm.spaceUsedByTape_le_spaceUsed _ t i).trans hs
    have hmem : ∀ z ∈ M.tm.visitedByTapeHead (M.tm.initCfg x) t i, |z| ≤ s := fun z hz =>
      ((M.tm.abs_pos_lt_card_visited x t i hz).trans_le (by exact_mod_cast hcard)).le
    refine ⟨hmem _ ?_, fun z hz => hmem z ?_⟩
    · exact (MultiTapeTM.mem_visitedByTapeHead_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩
    · exact M.tm.visitedByTapeHead_mono _ ht' i (M.tm.mem_visited_of_ne_none x t' i z hz)
  -- injectivity of the code map on times before `T`
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun t' => coreCode s (M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t'))
      (Finset.range T : Set ℕ) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio] at ha hb
    have hc := coreCode_inj s (hbound a (by omega)) (hbound b (by omega)) hab
    by_contra hne
    rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h' | h'
    · exact core_injOn M.tm _ T hT hmin h' hb hc
    · exact core_injOn M.tm _ T hT hmin h' ha hc.symm
  have hcardT : T ≤ M.configBound x.length s := by
    have := Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn _ (fun a _ => Finset.mem_univ _) hinj
    simp only [Finset.card_range, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_option,
      Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_pi, Finset.prod_const, Fintype.card_bool] at this
    rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm (2 * s + 1) M.k] at this
    refine this.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    simp only [configBound]
    ring
  have hfin : M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) (M.configBound x.length s) =
      M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T := by
    rw [show M.configBound x.length s = T + (M.configBound x.length s - T) by omega,
      runFrom_add, runFrom_of_halt _ hT]
  have hfin' : M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) t = M.tm.runFrom (M.tm.initCfg x) T :=
    heq.symm
  rw [hfin]
  exact ⟨hT, by rw [← hfin']; exact hout⟩
review: spaceUsedByTape_eq_card and mem_visitedByTapeHead_iff are published theorems. configBound is same-owner def; remaining args are local facts/theorems. No foreign/Core definition argument.

private lemma b2_verify_timed (S V : FinTM Bool) {x : List Bool}
    (y : List Bool) (b : Bool) (T : ℕ) (hV : V.ComputesInTime y [b] T)
    (p : Fin (x.length + 2)) (tapes : Fin S.k → ℤ → Option Bool)
    (heads : Fin S.k → ℤ) (w : List Bool) (hw : w.length = T + 1) :
    let out := (b2Host S V).tm.runWith w
      (b2VerifyCfg S V (V.tm.initCfg y) true p tapes heads)
    out.state = none ∧ out.output = [b] := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hlive, heq⟩ := MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt V.tm (V.tm.initCfg y)
    (((computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp hV).1)
  let c := V.tm.runFrom (V.tm.initCfg y) t
  have hc : c.state = none :=
    (congrArg Cfg.state heq).trans ((computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mp hV).1
  have hcomp : V.ComputesInTime y c.output t :=
    (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨hc, rfl⟩
  have ho : c.output = [b] := hcomp.output_unique hV
  have hp : (w.take t).length = t := List.length_take_of_le (by omega)
  obtain ⟨tag, _, hr⟩ := b2_verify_run S V (V.tm.initCfg y) true
    (by simp [VirtualTag_iff, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_inputPos]) p tapes heads (w.take t)
    (fun s hs => hlive s (show s < t from hp ▸ hs))
  rw [hp] at hr
  have hlen : 0 < (w.drop t).length := by rw [List.length_drop]; omega
  cases hd : w.drop t with
  | nil => simp [hd] at hlen
  | cons bit rest =>
    have hf := b2_verify_finish S V c hc tag p tapes heads bit
    have hout : ((b2Host S V).tm.stepWith bit
        (b2VerifyCfg S V c tag p tapes heads)).output = [b] := by
      rw [hf.2, ho]
      cases b <;> simp
    have hsplit : w = w.take t ++ bit :: rest := by rw [← hd, List.take_append_drop]
    dsimp only
    rw [hsplit, NDTM.runWith_append, hr, NDTM.runWith_cons,
      NDTM.runWith_of_halt _ hf.1]
    exact ⟨hf.1, hout⟩
review: VirtualTag_iff, MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq and Cfg.init_inputPos are published theorems. Remaining args are local facts or existing theorem readers; no foreign/Core definition argument.

lemma clockTM_setup (x s : List Bool) (tK : ℕ) (hK : K.ComputesInTime x s tK) :
    ∃ (a : ℕ) (kt : Fin K.k → ℤ → Option Bool) (kh : Fin K.k → ℤ),
      a ≤ tK + s.length + x.length + 5 ∧
      (clockTM K W).tm.runFrom ((clockTM K W).tm.initCfg x) a =
        ctrCfg K W (some (.dec W.tm.q₀ .empty)) (W.tm.initCfg x) (bufferTape s) 0 kt kh [] := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hlive, hcut⟩ := MultiTapeTM.exists_first_halt K.tm (K.tm.initCfg x)
    (((computesInTime_iff K x s tK).mp hK).1)
  let c := K.tm.runFrom (K.tm.initCfg x) t
  have hs : c.state = none :=
    (congrArg Cfg.state hcut).trans ((computesInTime_iff K x s tK).mp hK).1
  have hc : K.ComputesInTime x c.output t := (computesInTime_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨hs, rfl⟩
  have ho : c.output = s := hc.output_unique hK
  -- the input rewind
  let start := ctrCfg K W (some .iStart) ⟨none, c.inputPos, fun _ _ => none, fun _ => 0, []⟩
    (bufferTape c.output) 0 c.workTapes c.workTapePos []
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrun⟩ := timed_rewind (clockTM K W).tm ClockState.iStart ClockState.iScan
    (some (.dec W.tm.q₀ .empty)) (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun inp _ => by cases inp <;> rfl)
    start rfl
  refine ⟨t + (c.output.length + 2) + r, c.workTapes, c.workTapePos, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hp : start.inputPos.val ≤ x.length + 1 := by
      have := start.inputPos.isLt
      omega
    rw [ho] at *
    omega
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, MultiTapeTM.runFrom_add, kCfg_init,
      kCfg_run K W _ t hlive, kCfg_rewind K W c hs, hrun, ← ho]
    have hi : (W.tm.initCfg x).inputPos = 1 := by
      rw [MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_inputPos]
    have hw : (W.tm.initCfg x).workTapes = (fun _ _ => none) := by
      funext i z
      rw [MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_workTapes]
    have hp : (W.tm.initCfg x).workTapePos = (fun _ => 0) := by
      funext i
      rw [MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_workTapePos]
    apply Cfg.ext <;> simp only [ctrCfg, start, hi, hw, hp]
